name: Brisbane City Council Environment Grants
summary: Council grants for not-for-profit community groups in Brisbane: on-ground environmental and community garden projects (category 1) and running costs of environment groups (category 2).

amount.note: Category 1 on-ground projects $1,000-$25,000; category 2 operational costs $1,000-$8,000

eligibility.rule: Be incorporated or auspiced by a non-profit incorporated body able to accept legal and financial responsibility
Have projects or administration expenses based within the Brisbane Local Government Area
Have no outstanding debts or overdue, unacquitted grants with Council
Carry out on-ground projects on Council land with written approval
Not have started projects or committed expenditure before the grant round notification date
Not deliver projects that are the core responsibility of another level of government
Have an assured source of ongoing funding when the application requires ongoing funding

documents: Written approval from the local Council land manager or Regional Council Coordinator, for on-ground projects
Necessary permits under State Acts and Council local laws, if relevant
Consultation and written approval evidence from relevant stakeholders
Two comparable quotes for items or services above $1,000 and one quote for items or services under $1,000
Quote from a licensed plumber when constructing a raingarden

status.quote: Applications for this grant open from 5 October 2026 and close 2 November 2026.

opens.quote: Applications for this grant open from 5 October 2026 and close 2 November 2026.

deadline.quote: Applications for this grant open from 5 October 2026 and close 2 November 2026.

applicant_types.quote: Environment grants provide funding to not-for-profit community groups and organisations.

geography.quote: your projects and administration expenses are delivering or supporting projects that are based within the Brisbane Local Government Area

access.quote: All applications are submitted via our online application system, SmartyGrants.

window.quote: Applications for this grant open from 5 October 2026 and close 2 November 2026.

amount.quote: Category 1: $1,000-$25,000 (Community Gardens applicants: up to $2,500) Category 2: $1,000-$8,000

co_finance_required.quote: The applicant must provide a co-contribution to meet the full costs of all projects.

effort.quote: Applications for this grant open from 5 October 2026 and close 2 November 2026.
Provided the eligibility criteria for making a grant application under these guidelines are satisfied, the project will be assessed against the following assessment criteria.

eligibility.quote: The organisation must be a not-for-profit community-based group that is incorporated or be auspiced by a non-profit incorporated body that is able to accept legal and financial responsibility for the project and its activities.
Grants will only be available to organisations where projects and administration expenses are delivering or supporting projects that are based within the LGA.
Applicants (and their auspice) must not have outstanding debts or overdue, unacquitted grants with Council.
On-ground projects must be carried out on Council land and be accompanied by written approval from the local Council land manager or Regional Council Coordinator (land manager representative).
Projects that have already commenced or projects to which your organisation has committed expenditure before the grant round notification date.
Projects that are the core responsibility of other levels of government e.g. the Queensland Government's Department of Education and Training.
Applications that require ongoing funding, unless the source of ongoing funding is assured.

co_finance.quote: Environmental projects - The applicant must provide a co-contribution to meet the full costs of all projects. This could be cash or in-kind contributions.
